phases.name: scoping
phases.note: SCOPE-123 authored from 7 field reports across 3 projects; preflight 100

openQuestions: Where the FR-003 advance is placed: shared service or database trigger. It must be ONE place reachable by both the app task service and the MCP tool.
The derivation rule for a project rollup stage (FR-006): lowest scope stage, highest, or most common. The choice is visible to customers on the board.
Whether the FR-007 backfill runs automatically on upgrade or as an explicit command.

decisions.decision: A stage belongs to a scope, not a project; each scope moves independently once its tasks complete; a project never stops a scope from moving.
decisions.rationale: Stated by the product owner. Settles two questions open at drafting: scope-driven advance is the model rather than a governance decision, and no project-stage advance command is needed because the project stage stops being a gate.
decisions.consequence: resolveCurrentPhase is demoted to display/rollup only, and projectspecifications.phaseid loses its readers.

decisions.rationale: FR-009 consumes its unified vocabulary; building 123 first would wire specificationphases while four vocabularies disagree.
